name: Deltasuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Paluxysuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in Neosuchia, the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Deltasuchus is a large neosuchian crocodyliform from the Cenomanian Woodbine Formation of Texas.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Lewisville Member of the Woodbine Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Adams et al. 2017

sources.text: Adams, T.L.; Noto, C.R.; Drumheller, S. 2017. A large neosuchian crocodyliform from the Upper Cretaceous (Cenomanian) Woodbine Formation of North Texas. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 37(4). doi:10.1080/02724634.2017.1349776
